title: Super admin wallet
footNote: Super admin wallet · private use · its own database, its own sign-in
isolationNote: This account is fully separate. Cash in or out here never touches the Bhabaghure Holidays balance or any other business ledger — it is the super admin’s own cash record.

errors.network: The wallet couldn’t be reached. Check the connection and try again.

signIn.title: Open the wallet
signIn.note: Your admin email and password, then the code from your authenticator app. The wallet keeps its own session: signing in here doesn’t sign you in to the admin, or the other way round.
signIn.enrollNote: Scan this with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…), then enter the 6-digit code it shows. This is shown only until the first code is accepted.
signIn.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
signIn.codeNote: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

cash.referenceIn: Reference · what this money is for
cash.evidenceNote: Receipt, bank slip or bKash screenshot · image or PDF, up to 5 MB
cash.evidenceChosen: Encrypted when saved · tap × to remove
cash.evidenceTooBig: Over 5 MB: attach a smaller photo or scan

deals.title: Deals · advance & due
deals.name: Company or client
deals.preview: Advance {{advance}} will be added to your balance · {{due}} stays due
deals.advanceOverTotal: The advance can’t be more than the deal total.
deals.savedWithAdvance: Deal saved · advance {{amount}} added to balance

history.title: Transaction history
history.reverseNote: An entry the other way is added for “{{reference}}”, with your reason. Nothing is deleted.
